_meta.note: Rebuilt 2026-08-03. The previous map held only 61 players covering the week-17 test pair (Julio's Last Hurrah + Chase Sapphire). Matt's team missed the playoffs, so 6 of the 7 playoff teams had ZERO mapped players and therefore zero stats. This map covers the full 2026 league player pool.

corrections.why: MLB people/search on the surname-first string "Rodriguez, Endy" returned Julio Rodriguez (677594) first; the resolver took the first active hit without verifying the returned name matched. Julio Rodriguez was being scored for Nick Kurtz in Paris for all of Week 2 while the real Endy Rodriguez (682848) had not played since 2026-08-07.
